cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're on stage two of making up. Choose a biscuit; refreshments come before the difficult conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate all my biscuits. That is the difficult conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stage one is complete: we've named the grievance. Give me the tin, please. We'll establish what needs replacing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want the same ones, not the cheap packet you brought last time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brand-specific restitution. Good. Write the name down; I'll go now. Please leave the tin here so we can verify the replacement properly.
